map.氢原子能级：E_n = −13.6 ÷ n²（eV，n 四舍五入取整）；联动量：: Hydrogen atom energy levels: E_n = −13.6 ÷ n² (eV, n rounded to an integer); linked values: ionization energy = |E_n| (eV), energy released by transition to the ground state = 13.6 − 13.6 ÷ n² (eV). Validation: non-empty guard for n. Criteria: no fixed grading; a larger n brings the level closer to 0, with the ground state n = 1 at −13.6 eV.
